0613Software and applications development and analysis

IWIBench

hcltech-robotics/iwibench

Edit a target model's weights through four bounded tools to change one behaviour while preserving other capabilities.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • intraweight injection RL
  • weight-space programming research

Reward

How it is scored
Mixed
Signal
Graded, 0 to 1

Reward combines improvement on the target behaviour with retention of other capabilities, using deterministic checks and a pinned semantic judge for qualified sessions.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

python -m iwibench.service --model google/gemma-3-4b-it --output-dir runs/target
vf-run iwibench @ configs/variants.toml --dry-run

2. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download hcltech-robotics/iwibench --repo-type dataset --local-dir iwibench

Framework documentation: Verifiers. Needs: CUDA GPU, gated Gemma checkpoints, OPENAI_API_KEY for the judge.

Evidence

Tasks were baseline-qualified on Gemma 3 4B IT with controls and an algebraic no-op check.

As reported by the publisher. We have not reproduced it.
